criteria.statement: The source contains no module for a staff console, a returns workflow, a jobs listing or a legal document library, none of which the brief asks for.
The source declares no client library for a second datastore, an object store, a cache, a queue or a third party mail vendor in its dependency manifest.
The source keeps the scroll driver, the cart controls, the firmware installer and the serial register row as the only client-side modules, with every other route built as server-rendered markup.
The source carries no analytics client, no consent module and no outbound tracking beacon.
Money is represented as an integer count of minor units in every module that touches it, with no float arithmetic and no currency parsing from formatted strings.
One shared helper resolves the acting customer for every account-scoped query, rather than each handler repeating its own ownership filter.
One seeding routine owns the catalogue, the devices, the releases and the firmware images, and is written so a second run inserts nothing.
Every host, port and credential the app needs is read through one configuration module that reads the environment, with no literal host or port elsewhere in the source.
The four release note groups are declared once as an ordered constant and referenced from every module that reads or writes them.
